title: 第19课 · 你没看出来吗
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 19 — 你没看出来吗 · Didn't you recognise him

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家 — At home

items.zh: 耳朵
items.py: ěrduo
items.en: ear

items.zh: 脸
items.py: liǎn
items.en: face

items.zh: 短
items.py: duǎn
items.en: short

items.zh: 爸爸：女儿最近喜欢把头发放在耳朵后面，你知道为什么吗？
items.py: Bàba: Nǚ'ér zuìjìn xǐhuan bǎ tóufa fàng zài ěrduo hòumian, nǐ zhīdào wèi shénme ma?
items.en: Dad: Lately our daughter likes to tuck her hair behind her ears. Do you know why?

items.zh: 妈妈：这样可以使她的脸看上去漂亮一些。
items.py: Māma: Zhèyàng kěyǐ shǐ tā de liǎn kàn shangqu piàoliang yīxiē.
items.en: Mum: That makes her face look a bit prettier.

items.zh: 爸爸：我最近觉得她和以前不太一样了。
items.py: Bàba: Wǒ zuìjìn juéde tā hé yǐqián bù tài yīyàng le.
items.en: Dad: Lately I feel she's not quite the same as before.

items.zh: 妈妈：女儿变化不小，她小时候喜欢短头发，像男孩子一样。
items.py: Māma: Nǚ'ér biànhuà bù xiǎo, tā xiǎo shíhou xǐhuan duǎn tóufa, xiàng nán háizi yīyàng.
items.en: Mum: She's changed quite a bit. When she was little she liked short hair, just like a boy.

items.zh: 爸爸：我也想起来了。她现在慢慢地开始像个女孩子了。
items.py: Bàba: Wǒ yě xiǎng qilai le. Tā xiànzài mànmàn de kāishǐ xiàng ge nǚ háizi le.
items.en: Dad: I remember that too. Now she's slowly starting to look like a girl.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在看照片 — Looking at a photo

items.zh: 马
items.py: mǎ
items.en: horse

items.zh: 张
items.py: zhāng
items.en: measure word for flat objects (paper, photos)

items.zh: 位
items.py: wèi
items.en: respectful measure word for people

items.zh: 蓝
items.py: lán
items.en: blue

items.zh: 小丽：上次我们参加骑马比赛的照片，我选了几张洗出来了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shàng cì wǒmen cānjiā qí mǎ bǐsài de zhàopiàn, wǒ xuǎn le jǐ zhāng xǐ chulai le.
items.en: Xiaoli: I picked a few of the photos from the horse-riding race we took part in last time and had them printed.

items.zh: 同事：快给我看看。骑得最快的这位是谁？
items.py: Tóngshì: Kuài gěi wǒ kànkan. Qí de zuì kuài de zhè wèi shì shéi?
items.en: Colleague: Quick, let me see. Who's this riding the fastest?

items.zh: 小丽：你没看出来吗？他是小刚啊。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nǐ méi kàn chulai ma? Tā shì Xiǎogāng a.
items.en: Xiaoli: Didn't you recognise him? It's Xiaogang.

items.zh: 同事：怎么看上去跟现在不太一样？
items.py: Tóngshì: Zěnme kàn shangqu gēn xiànzài bù tài yīyàng?
items.en: Colleague: How come he looks so different from now?

items.zh: 小丽：他上班穿西服、衬衫，比赛的时候穿的是运动服。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Tā shàng bān chuān xīfú, chènshān, bǐsài de shíhou chuān de shì yùndòngfú.
items.en: Xiaoli: At work he wears a suit and shirt; in the race he was wearing sportswear.

items.zh: 同事：他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁，还是穿运动服让他更年轻。
items.py: Tóngshì: Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shangqu xiàng sìshí duō suì, háishi chuān yùndòngfú ràng tā gèng niánqīng.
items.en: Colleague: Today he's wearing a blue suit and looks over 40. Sportswear makes him look younger.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在小丽家 — At Xiaoli's home

items.zh: 秋（天）
items.py: qiū (tiān)
items.en: autumn, fall

items.zh: 过
items.py: guò
items.en: to spend, to pass

items.zh: 鸟
items.py: niǎo
items.en: bird

items.zh: 哭
items.py: kū
items.en: to cry

items.zh: 朋友：我们一年没见面了吧？
items.py: Péngyou: Wǒmen yī nián méi jiàn miàn le ba?
items.en: Friend: We haven't seen each other for a year, have we?

items.zh: 小丽：听说你都有女儿了？她多大了？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Tīngshuō nǐ dōu yǒu nǚ'ér le? Tā duō dà le?
items.en: Xiaoli: I heard you already have a daughter? How old is she?

items.zh: 朋友：她去年秋天出生的，刚过完一岁生日。
items.py: Péngyou: Tā qùnián qiūtiān chūshēng de, gāng guò wán yī suì shēngrì.
items.en: Friend: She was born last autumn and has just had her first birthday.

items.zh: 小丽：她喜欢什么？我送给她。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Tā xǐhuan shénme? Wǒ sòng gěi tā.
items.en: Xiaoli: What does she like? I'll give it to her as a present.

items.zh: 朋友：她就喜欢听她爸爸学鸟叫。哭的时候，只要她爸爸学小鸟叫，她马上就安静下来了。
items.py: Péngyou: Tā jiù xǐhuan tīng tā bàba xué niǎo jiào. Kū de shíhou, zhǐyào tā bàba xué xiǎo niǎo jiào, tā mǎshàng jiù ānjìng xialai le.
items.en: Friend: She just loves hearing her dad imitate birdsong. When she cries, as soon as her dad imitates a little bird, she calms down right away.

items.zh: 小丽：啊？这个礼物我没办法送。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Á? Zhège lǐwù wǒ méi bànfǎ sòng.
items.en: Xiaoli: What? That's a present I can't give.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 短文 — An unforgettable trip

items.zh: 黄河
items.py: Huáng Hé
items.en: Yellow River (China's second longest river)

items.zh: 船
items.py: chuán
items.en: boat, ship

items.zh: 经过
items.py: jīngguò
items.en: to pass by

items.zh: 这次旅游，我去了不少地方，每个地方都让我非常难忘。
items.py: Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ qù le bù shǎo dìfang, měi ge dìfang dōu ràng wǒ fēicháng nánwàng.
items.en: On this trip I went to quite a few places, and every one of them was unforgettable.

items.zh: 我先去看了黄河，黄河是中国有名的大河，我坐在船上，一边看一边照相。
items.py: Wǒ xiān qù kàn le Huáng Hé, Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguó yǒumíng de dà hé, wǒ zuò zài chuán shang, yībiān kàn yībiān zhào xiàng.
items.en: First I went to see the Yellow River, a famous great river of China. I sat on a boat, looking around and taking photos.

items.zh: 一路上经过了很多地方，每个地方都不一样。
items.py: Yī lù shang jīngguò le hěn duō dìfang, měi ge dìfang dōu bù yīyàng.
items.en: Along the way I passed through many places, each one different.

items.zh: 我想快点儿把照片发给大家，叫朋友们也高兴高兴。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng kuài diǎnr bǎ zhàopiàn fā gěi dàjiā, jiào péngyoumen yě gāoxìng gāoxìng.
items.en: I want to send the photos to everyone soon, so my friends can enjoy them too.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (V + 出来: something new emerges)

items.zh: 这个字你能写出来吗？
items.py: Zhège zì nǐ néng xiě chulai ma?
items.en: Can you write this character?

items.zh: 朋友想出来一个学汉语的好办法。
items.py: Péngyou xiǎng chulai yī ge xué Hànyǔ de hǎo bànfǎ.
items.en: My friend came up with a good way to learn Chinese.

items.zh: 你画得真快，一会儿就画出来了。
items.py: Nǐ huà de zhēn kuài, yīhuìr jiù huà chulai le.
items.en: You draw really fast — you finished it in no time.

items.zh: 照片我选了几张洗出来了。
items.py: Zhàopiàn wǒ xuǎn le jǐ zhāng xǐ chulai le.
items.en: I picked a few photos and had them printed.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (V + 出来: recognising)

items.zh: 你听出来了吗？这是谁的声音？
items.py: Nǐ tīng chulai le ma? Zhè shì shéi de shēngyīn?
items.en: Can you tell? Whose voice is this?

items.zh: 我看出来了，这是二年级的那个女孩子。
items.py: Wǒ kàn chulai le, zhè shì èr niánjí de nàge nǚ háizi.
items.en: I recognise her — it's that girl from the second year.

items.zh: 我喝不出来这两杯咖啡有什么不一样。
items.py: Wǒ hē bu chūlái zhè liǎng bēi kāfēi yǒu shénme bù yīyàng.
items.en: I can't taste any difference between these two cups of coffee.

items.zh: 你没看出来吗？他是小刚啊。
items.py: Nǐ méi kàn chulai ma? Tā shì Xiǎogāng a.
items.en: Didn't you recognise him? It's Xiaogang.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Adj/V + 下来: slowing, calming)

items.zh: 前边的车越开越慢，停下来了。
items.py: Qiánbian de chē yuè kāi yuè màn, tíng xialai le.
items.en: The car in front drove slower and slower and came to a stop.

items.zh: 天黑下来了，孩子们要回家了。
items.py: Tiān hēi xialai le, háizimen yào huí jiā le.
items.en: It's getting dark; the children are going home.

items.zh: 我真希望时间能慢下来，不要过得那么快。
items.py: Wǒ zhēn xīwàng shíjiān néng màn xialai, bù yào guò de nàme kuài.
items.en: I really wish time could slow down and not pass so quickly.

items.zh: 只要他爸爸学小鸟叫，她马上就安静下来了。
items.py: Zhǐyào tā bàba xué xiǎo niǎo jiào, tā mǎshàng jiù ānjìng xialai le.
items.en: As soon as her dad imitates a little bird, she calms down right away.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (V + 起来: recalling)

items.zh: 你记起来我是谁了吗？
items.py: Nǐ jì qilai wǒ shì shéi le ma?
items.en: Do you remember who I am now?

items.zh: 你能想起来那是什么时候的事吗？
items.py: Nǐ néng xiǎng qilai nà shì shénme shíhou de shì ma?
items.en: Can you remember when that happened?

items.zh: 对不起，我想不起来你的名字了。
items.py: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ xiǎng bu qǐlái nǐ de míngzi le.
items.en: Sorry, I can't remember your name.

items.zh: 我想起来了，她小时候像个男孩子。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng qilai le, tā xiǎo shíhou xiàng ge nán háizi.
items.en: I remember now — when she was little she was like a boy.

items.zh: 把头发放在耳朵后边，可以使脸看上去漂亮一些。
items.py: Bǎ tóufa fàng zài ěrduo hòubian, kěyǐ shǐ liǎn kàn shangqu piàoliang yīxiē.
items.en: Tucking your hair behind your ears can make your face look a bit prettier.

items.zh: 他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁。
items.py: Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shangqu xiàng sìshí duō suì.
items.en: Today he's wearing a blue suit and looks over 40.

items.zh: 这是你做的饭吗？看起来很好吃。
items.py: Zhè shì nǐ zuò de fàn ma? Kàn qilai hěn hǎochī.
items.en: Did you cook this? It looks delicious.

items.zh: 他今天一句话也没说，看起来有点儿不高兴。
items.py: Tā jīntiān yī jù huà yě méi shuō, kàn qilai yǒudiǎnr bù gāoxìng.
items.en: He hasn't said a word today; he looks a bit unhappy.

items.zh: 读书使我快乐。
items.py: Dú shū shǐ wǒ kuàilè.
items.en: Reading makes me happy.

items.zh: 考试让我很紧张。
items.py: Kǎoshì ràng wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng.
items.en: Exams make me nervous.

items.zh: 穿运动服让他更年轻。
items.py: Chuān yùndòngfú ràng tā gèng niánqīng.
items.en: Wearing sportswear makes him look younger.

items.zh: 我想快点儿把照片发给大家，叫朋友们也高兴高兴。
items.py: Wǒ xiǎng kuài diǎnr bǎ zhàopiàn fā gěi dàjiā, jiào péngyoumen yě gāoxìng gāoxìng.
items.en: I want to send the photos to everyone soon, so my friends can enjoy them too.

items.en: walk + pass by → to pass by (on the way)
